facts.text: Linfield University covers each student's first roundtrip airfare for approved study abroad programs.

sources.title: Linfield receives national grant to expand access to study abroad
sources.quote: Linfield also covers each student's first roundtrip airfare and offers additional scholarships to further reduce costs.

facts.text: The Linfield Curriculum general education requirement provides a coherent experience spanning the arts and humanities, natural sciences, and social-behavioral sciences.

sources.title: The Linfield Curriculum (LC) (General Education Requirements ...
sources.quote: The purpose of the general education requirement called the Linfield Curriculum is to foster the development of wholly-educated persons by providing a coherent experience spanning the arts and humanities, natural sciences, and social-behavioral sciences.
